topic: Asking the Doctor to Sign a School Sports Form

script.title: SIGNING THE SPORTS FORM
script.scene_zh: 診所櫃台 · 簽體育表
script.story_hook: Four pages, one signature, and a Friday deadline.
script.intro_zh: 四頁表格、一個簽名，還有一個週五的期限。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a clinic desk on a busy Friday. Listen for form words made friendly.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到週五忙碌的診所櫃台。留意那些把表格話說得親切的說法。
script.outro: And that's one form, saved for the afternoon. Listen once more, then try it yourself.
script.outro_zh: 一張表格，就這樣留到下午簽好。再聽一次，然後自己試試看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's read each line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句大聲讀出來。
script.char_a_description: a bright-eyed woman in her early thirties with long blonde braids, a soft grey cardigan, a canvas tote on one shoulder, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a gentle man in his fifties with curly steel-grey hair, a thick moustache, a pale blue nurse uniform, reading glasses on a chain, and a heavy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I brought the school sports form for my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ ˈbrɔt ðə skuːl ˈspɔrts ˈfɔrm fɚ ˈmaɪ sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我帶我兒子的學校體育檢查表過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I have his file right here, nine years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt aɪ hæv hɪz ˈfaɪl ɹaɪt hɪɹ naɪn jɪɹz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 正好，他的資料就在我這裡，九歲對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, Leo, and PE starts Monday, so this is urgent.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈlioʊ ænd ˌpi ˈi ˈstɑɹts ˈmʌndeɪ soʊ ðɪs ɪz ˈɜɹdʒənt/
dialogue.zh: 對，他叫 Leo，星期一就有體育課，所以很急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Urgent forms are my favorite kind, let's look together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜɹdʒənt fɔɹmz ɑɹ maɪ ˈfeɪvɹɪt kaɪnd lɛts lʊk təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 急件是我最喜歡的那種，我們一起看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, section one is names, I filled that part.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈsɛkʃən wʌn ɪz ˈneɪmz aɪ fɪld ðæt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 好，第一部分是姓名，那一欄我填好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, section two is history, like allergies or asthma.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈsɛkʃən tu ɪz ˈhɪstɹi laɪk əˈlɜɹdʒiz ɔɹ æzmə/
dialogue.zh: 很好，第二部分是病史，像是過敏或氣喘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, he uses an inhaler before soccer games.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm hi ˈjuzɪz æn ɪnˈheɪlɚ bɪˈfɔɹ ˈsɑkɚ ɡeɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，他踢足球之前會用吸入劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll note that here, it comes from sports, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl noʊt ðæt hɪɹ ɪt ˈkʌmz fɹʌm ˈspɔɹts ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我在這裡註明，是運動引起的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only when it's cold, the coach said to mention it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ɪts koʊld ðə koʊtʃ sɛd tə ˈmɛnʃən ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只有天氣冷的時候會，教練說要寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart coach, cold air triggers kids a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt koʊtʃ koʊld ɛɹ ˈtɹɪɡɚz kɪdz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 這教練真細心，冷空氣常常會讓小孩發作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I should list the inhaler on the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ʃʊd lɪst ði ɪnˈheɪlɚ ɑn ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 所以我應該把吸入劑寫在表格上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that way school keeps one in the nurse bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛs ðæt weɪ ˈskuːl ˈkips wʌn ɪn ðə ˈnɝs bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那樣學校就會在護理包裡備一支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you keep a spare there? That's a relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ju kip ə spɛɹ ðɛɹ ðæts ə ɹiˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你們會放備用的？那我就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, labeled with his name and the dose.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ˈleɪbəld wɪð hɪz neɪm ænd ðə doʊs/
dialogue.zh: 會的，上面貼他的名字和劑量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, he leaves his at the field every single time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt hi livz hɪz æt ðə filld ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好，他每次都把吸入劑落在球場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine-year-olds and fields, that's a classic pair, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈjɪɹˌoʊldz ænd filldz ðæts ə ˈklæsɪk pɛɹ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，九歲的小孩和球場，這對組合很經典。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very true. Now, what about these blank boxes here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛɹi tru naʊ wɑt əˈbaʊt ðiz blæŋ ˈbɑkˌsɪz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 真的。那這幾個空白的格子該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are mine, height, weight, vision, and blood pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ɑɹ maɪn haɪt weɪt ˈvɪʒən ænd blʌd ˈpɹɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那些是我的部分，身高、體重、視力、血壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stand him on the scale right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈstænd hɪm ɑn ðə skeɪl ˈɹaɪt ˈnaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在要請他站上秤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need today, last check is still on file.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid təˈdeɪ læst tʃɛk ɪz stɪl ɑn faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 今天不用，上次檢查的資料還在檔案裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's from March, is that old enough for school?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fɹʌm mɑɹtʃ ɪz ðæt oʊld ɪˈnʌf fɚ skuːl/
dialogue.zh: 那是三月留的資料，學校還接受嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: School wants one year, so March is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /skuːl ˈwɑnts wʌn jɪɹ soʊ ˈmɑɹtʃ ɪz ˈfaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 學校要一年以內的，所以三月剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, one less thing to measure, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wʌn lɛs θɪŋ tə ˈmɛʒɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，老實說，又少一項要量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I hear that one a lot, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑ aɪ ˈhiɹ ðæt wʌn ə ˈlɑt ˈtɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句話我常聽到，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So where does the doctor actually sign this?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛɹ dʌz ðə ˈdɑkɾɚ ˈæktʃuəli saɪn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那醫生到底要簽在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page four, one signature, four pages, that's the routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ fɔɹ wʌn ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ fɔɹ ˈpeɪdʒɪz ðæts ðə ruˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 第四頁，一個簽名、四頁表格，這就是流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One signature, four pages, and I thought vaccines were slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ fɔɹ ˈpeɪdʒɪz ænd aɪ θɔt vækˈsɪnz wɚ sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一個簽名、四頁表格，我原本以為打疫苗最慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paperwork is our hometown sport, we're all champions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚˌwɝk ɪz ɑɹ ˈhaʊmˌtaʊn spɔɹt wiɹ ɔl ˈtʃæmpiənz/
dialogue.zh: 文件是我們這裡的強項，個個都是冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that should go on a poster here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt ʃʊd ɡoʊ ɑn ə ˈpoʊstɚ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句話應該貼在牆上的海報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell my boss, she loves signs like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛl maɪ ˈbɑs ʃi ˈlʌvz ˈsaɪnz laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴我們主管，她最喜歡那種標語。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, is the doctor around, or is this your part?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪz ðə ˈdɑkɾɚ əˈɹaʊnd ɔɹ ɪz ðɪs jɔɹ pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那醫生現在人在這裡嗎，還是這部分歸你簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's mostly mine, he just signs the medical line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈmoʊstli maɪn hi dʒʌst saɪnz ðə ˈmɛdɪkəl laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 大部分是我，他只要簽醫療那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And where is he right now, if you don't mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈwɛɹ ɪz hi ˈɹaɪt naʊ ɪf ju ˈdoʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 請問他現在去哪裡了，問一下應該不麻煩吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's at lunch, and he's back at two thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiːz æt lʌntʃ ænd hiːz bæk æt tu ˈθɜɾi/
dialogue.zh: 他吃午飯去了，要兩點半才回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two thirty? I have pickup at two, um, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈθɜɾi aɪ hæv ˈpɪkˌʌp æt tu ʌm ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 兩點半？我兩點得去接小孩，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is tight, but I have a better option.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪz taɪt bʌt aɪ hæv ə ˈbɛɾɚ ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 兩點有點趕，但我有個更好的辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, I'll take the better option, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz aɪl teɪk ðə ˈbɛɾɚ ˈɑpʃən ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我就要那個更好的辦法，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the form here, pick it up after three.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə fɔɹm hɪɹ pɪk ɪt ʌp ˈæɾɚ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 把表格留在這裡，三點以後來拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After three, so he signs it while I'm gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæɾɚ θɹi soʊ hi saɪnz ɪt waɪl aɪm ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 三點以後，那趁我不在的時候他會簽好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and I'll text you when it's ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd aɪl tɛkst ju wɛn ɪts ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，我會傳訊息告訴你表格簽好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text confirmation, I love that part, no phone tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ˌkɑnəˈfeɪʃən aɪ lʌv ðæt pɑɹt noʊ foʊn tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 會傳訊息給我，我最愛這種，不用來回找電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No phone tag, my life motto, um, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊn tæɡ maɪ laɪf ˈmɑtoʊ ʌm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 不用來回找電話，這是我的人生座右銘，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one worry, the form says due today, Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌn ˈwɜɹi ðə fɔɹm sɛz du təˈdeɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，還有一個擔心，表上寫著今天週五到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, yes, school gave you the whole week, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ jɛs skuːl ɡeɪv ju ðə hoʊl wik hʌh/
dialogue.zh: 週五，對啊，學校給了你們整整一週，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole week I kept meaning to walk in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl wik aɪ kɛpt ˈminɪŋ tə wɔk ɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 整整一週，我一直想著要跑這一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're in here now, and I've got the pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjʊɹz ɪn hɪɹ ˈnaʊ ænd aɪv ˈɡɑt ðə ˈpɛn/
dialogue.zh: 你現在不就來了，我手上也剛好有筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also add a note about his knee?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ æd ə noʊt əˈbaʊt hɪz ni/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在上面加註他膝蓋的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, does it ache now, was it ever checked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ dʊz ɪt ətʃ naʊ wəz ɪt ˈɛvɚ tʃɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，他現在還會痛嗎？之前有檢查過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, just sore after long runs, I think he's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst sɔɹ ˈæɾɚ lɔŋ ɹʌnz aɪ θɪŋk hiz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只是跑久之後會痠，我覺得還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write that, watch it if it swells, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt ðæt wɑtʃ ɪt ɪf ɪt swɛlz oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我寫上去，如果腫起來就要看診，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any fee for a copy of the signed page?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni fi fɚ ə ˈkɑpi ʌv ðə saɪnd peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 簽好的那頁要複製的話，有費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee, we email a PDF, the school likes that.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fi wi ˈimel ə ˌpidaɪˈɛf ðə skuːl laɪks ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們用電子郵件傳 PDF，學校喜歡那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my email is the one on the file?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ ˈimel ɪz ði wʌn ɑn ðə faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的信箱就是檔案裡那一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, and I'll copy the coach, if that's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ænd aɪl ˈkɑpi ðə koʊtʃ ɪf ðæts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，我也會抄送給教練，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, the coach keeps asking me, poor man.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðə koʊtʃ kips ˈæskɪŋ mi pʊɹ mæn/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，教練一直問我，也滿可憐的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, Leo's fine, he just needs a signed page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdoʊnt ˈwɝi ˈlioʊz faɪn hi dʒʌst nidz ə saɪnd ˈpeɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 放心吧，Leo 沒事，他只需要一張簽好的表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the nicest thing I've heard all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈnaɪsɪst θɪŋ aɪv hɜɹd ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這一週聽到最溫暖的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll sign that compliment, it goes on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl saɪn ðæt ˈkɑmpləmənt ɪt ɡoʊz ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我要在那句話上簽名，貼上牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, I'll be back at three fifteen, maybe sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪl bi bæk æt θɹi ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmeɪbi ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，我三點十五分回來，也許更早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three fifteen, door's open, um, bring that Friday energy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˌfɪfˈtin dɔɹz ˈoʊpən ʌm brɪŋ ðæt ˈfɹaɪdeɪ ˈɛnɚdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 三點十五分，門會開著，嗯，帶著週五的元氣來。

script.youtube_title: 【週五要交的體育檢查表📄】「一個簽名四頁表格」教你請診所簽好蓋章✍️🩺🎧｜聽完不怕追表格｜60句沉浸式英文聽力｜School Sports Form
script.youtube_title_en: "One Signature, Four Pages" — Getting a School Sports Form Signed at the Clinic
script.youtube_description:
週五要交的學校體育檢查表，怎麼在診所一個下午就搞定？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在診所櫃台，從交表格、填病史，一路聽到醫生去吃午飯、改用留下表格再回來拿的辦法。

你會聽到：怎麼開口交表格 I brought the school sports form for my son；怎麼講清楚吸入劑和氣喘這一段病史；表格哪一欄是護理師簽、哪一行要醫生簽；還有身高體重視力血壓欄位、一年以內的舊檢查能不能用、今天到期怎麼辦的實用問句。

整段只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人在診所前後櫃的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、honestly、trust me。聽完你就會用：Let's look together、On file、Pick it up after three、I'll text you、Don't worry。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

孩子的學校體育檢查表四頁，週五就要交，醫生卻剛走去吃午飯，這種情況你該怎麼開口？哪一欄是護理師簽，哪一行一定要醫生簽？吸入劑這種事，到底要寫在哪一段？
